fields.acceptance: Tests in internal/guide (build_test.go, review_test.go, plan_test.go) assert each of the three guides shows the `- <<'EOF'` form for every rhiza run findings and rhiza run verdict it names and that no `<file>` form of either command remains in them; go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... passes
fields.statement: The build, review and plan-review guides show rhiza run findings and rhiza run verdict fed from stdin by a heredoc (`- <<'EOF'` ... `EOF`), with their existing flags (--leaf, --check, --json) and JSON shapes, so an agent records findings and verdicts without a temp file or compound shell command
